title: Claims register entry
description: One statement a client could ask 'where is this from?' about: a regulation, date, threshold, penalty, provider capability, framework requirement, market figure, exchange rate or LTM heuristic. Engines and knowledge files refer to claims by id. Checked by scripts/check-claims.cjs (run in npm run check:repo).

jurisdiction.description: e.g. EU, UK, US, US-CA, SG, AU, IN, global

statement.description: The claim exactly as the product relies on it, in plain English

verification.description: V verified against text quoting the official source; S secondary only; P primary URL given, article not re-read; UNSOURCED not verified; COUNSEL reviewed by qualified counsel

volatile.description: Fast-changing (decision D8): reviewed at least every 90 days and shown with 'status as of'

clientVisible.description: False keeps the claim out of client mode (design Q7: unsourced content is consultant-only)

owner.description: Accountable reviewer, e.g. sovereignty-compliance-lead (agent) / product owner

basisNote.description: For heuristics: the reasoning; for UNSOURCED: what would settle it
